arXiv:2609.22991v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Apple Silicon machines with 192GB or more of unified memory make it routine to place tensors with more than $2^{32}$ elements on a desktop GPU. We show that PyTorch's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend silently returns wrong results for batched matrix multiplication at this scale.
